en: Vintage sepia-toned street scene showing a busy marketplace in a European town. Crowds of people in late‑19th or early‑20th century clothing fill a wide street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops on both sides. Market stalls, carts, and a horse-drawn wagon are visible. A tower with a small dome and flag rises in the background. Printed captions at the bottom read "Grossenhain. Frauenmarkt." and a publisher credit "Brück & Sohn, Meissen" together with the number 3463.
